name: Lee Hsien Loong
_note: Calibration benchmark, not a competitor. Scored on the identical instrument. M1 dry-run subject: data on file, below ranking validity (peer set < 3) so no composite or rank is published.

metrics.justification: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators: Singapore's Government Effectiveness percentile rank was 100 in 2023, the maximum on the index, with Rule of Law and Control of Corruption also in the top decile. Government effectiveness sits squarely within a head of government's remit, so this is in-domain for C2.

citation.title: Worldwide Governance Indicators — Government Effectiveness, Percentile Rank (GE.PER.RNK), Singapore, data year 2023

metrics.justification: As PAP Secretary-General the leader headed a single party holding a parliamentary supermajority (83 of the 93 elected seats after the 2020 general election). A lone majority party is the pivot in every coalition ordering, so its Shapley-Shubik power index is 1.0. Pivotality is descriptive structural weight, not a merit score.

citation.title: 2020 Parliamentary General Election — Declaration of Results

metrics.justification: No personal corruption charge or conviction of record. The 2017 allegations by his siblings over 38 Oxley Road were a family-property dispute aired in Parliament; the government's position, stated on the record, was that there was no basis to the abuse-of-power allegation, and no charge or adverse finding followed. Recorded as the subject's own factual status only.

citation.title: Ministerial Statement by PM Lee Hsien Loong on Alleged Abuse of Power on 38 Oxley Road
